name: Mindslice Frenzy (Recharge 5-6)
description: The creature makes four melee attacks. A creature hit by two or more of these attacks on a turn must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened for 1 minute. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn 20 ft. or more away from the creature.
